# Short title: what this builds

**Read first:** `docs/prompts/CONTEXT.md`, `docs/prompts/context/TRACK.md`, then what this builds on.
**Depends on:** generated by `sync` from prompts.toml. Do not edit.
**Lift:** S, M, L or XL (see below).
**Delivers:** one line. It goes in INDEX.md.
**Track:** what this must not touch.

## Goal

What a person can do afterwards that they cannot do now. A few sentences.

## Decided

Taken already. Do not re-litigate.

## Not in scope

Named by prompt, so nobody builds it twice.

## Requirements

Numbered, grouped A, B, C. Put a `compact` line between groups: checks green, status updated, then compact.
About 12 requirements and 150 lines at most. Bigger than that, split it.

## Acceptance criteria

Each one a test or a check someone can run. Standard checks pass. No network, Docker or real mail in tests.

## Open questions (defaults in bold)

Each with a default, so the build can go on.

## Report-back checkpoint

End with the report from `CONTEXT.md`, naming the open questions that took the default. Then stop.

<!-- Lift: S is one group, a small change. M is one module in one or two groups. L is several modules, three
or four groups. XL is five groups or a new subsystem. Think about splitting an XL. -->
